purpose: Compare a plain model call with a single agent and choose the smallest sufficient pattern.
input_contract: Learner has completed prompt and client-flow prerequisites.
output_contract: Learner chooses plain model or single agent and justifies the choice using goal, instructions, tools, and execution needs.

purpose: Design and test a safe single-agent workflow using an offline portal worksheet.
input_contract: Learner receives a bounded business scenario and tool catalog.
output_contract: Learner defines instructions, selects least-privilege tools, orders portal tests, traces the client flow, and blocks unauthorized action.
